description: Positioning framework for Empire Revenue OS GTM layer.

core_positioning.value_proposition: Turn any business, repo, creator brand, or landing page into a paid offer, buyer list, outreach campaign, payment path, and delivery receipt — by Monday.

objection_handling.not_ready: You don't need a perfect product. You need a sellable offer. We start with what you have.
objection_handling.no_time: The system generates everything. You just execute the outreach.
objection_handling.too_early: Revenue now funds product development later. Don't build in a vacuum.
objection_handling.done_before: This isn't a template or course. It's a generated system specific to your business.

messaging_pillars.message: From zero to paid offer in 24 hours. From offer to first sale in 72 hours.
Use what you have. We generate the system around your existing offer, skills, and audience.
proof_points: Manual payment fallback if no Stripe
